risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case/most uncertain option (cannot confirm exact model/region), and treat as not proven complete.

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing (controller, HDMI, power cable, USB cable, headset, etc.).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo showing every accessory individually (controller(s), all cables, manuals, box contents).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete (missing accessories), since completeness is not visible.

risks.risk: Games may be fewer than claimed, may be scratched/unreadable, or may not be included.
risks.proof: Photos of all game discs (front and back) and/or a video showing the games installed/recognized in the PS4 menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no guaranteed working games (worst case: treat as fewer/possibly not playable).

risks.risk: Condition/working status (disc drive, HDMI output, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, controller functionality) cannot be verified.
risks.proof: A short video booting the PS4 to the home screen, showing controller pairing and that at least one game disc loads.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / worst-case not guaranteed working.

risks.risk: Box shown may not match the actual console contents (photo could be packaging only).
risks.proof: Photo of the actual console next to the box, with the same serial/model label visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as uncertain authenticity/contents until matched to the real unit.

Photo of everything included laid out: controller(s), HDMI, power cable, USB cable, manuals, and any headset.
Photos of all 7 game discs (front and back) or a video showing the games listed/recognized on the PS4.
Short boot video to the home screen plus a quick test loading one game disc.
response.reason: From photo 0, only the box is visible; the PS4 model/version, region, accessories, and the claimed 7 games are not verifiable remotely. Without these, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
